name: Fireball
text: The target of this spell feels an invisible weight pile upon them, dragging them to the ground. When this spell binds to its target, they are knocked prone if the spell's power is greater than their Might. The target gains the spell’s power as bonus dice to resist any attempts to move or knock them down, and as a penalty to speed. Add this spell’s power to the difficulty of all Agility rolls they make. Standing up from prone requires a Might (Brawn) check with difficulty equal to this spell’s power.
